recap: Cavaliers beat the Nuggets 119–116 in overtime.
Lauri Markkanen led the Cavaliers with 31 points (11-18 FG, 6-12 3PT), 10 rebounds and 3 assists.
Nikola Jokic led the Nuggets with 32 points (15-24 FG, 0-4 3PT), 10 rebounds and 8 assists.
CLE won 2 of 4 factors: ball security, getting to the line. Effective FG% 52.0 to 55.4.
Biggest swing: Darius Garland offensive rebound (OT 28.3), +31 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): LeVert, Markkanen, Garland, Okoro, Love, +10 in 7:10.
Bench points: CLE 24, DEN 42. Points in the paint: 58–66. Second-chance points: 19–15.
